name: a new roadmap writes its record, then its title and the three genesis kinds in its tree
a title past 200 characters is refused before anything is written
a new roadmap's first steps join its tree's first intent, each first step after the one before
a new roadmap's linked first steps come with their links, a step after those it follows
a new roadmap's first steps that loop are refused
a new roadmap of more steps than a chunk holds commits them in further intents of its tree
deleting a root is held and writes its record's death
a subtree's record is not deleted on its own
a roadmap the device no longer draws is not deleted again
renaming writes the title alone in the roadmap's tree
a guide is written beside the title
the title a roadmap holds writes nothing
a guide past 5,000 characters is refused
a root's visibility is a field write under the tree's capture, predicting its reach and the reach of every standing subtree of its branch
a root with no subtree writes its visibility and predicts its own reach alone
the visibility a root holds writes nothing
a subtree's visibility is its root's
no other visibility is set
a roadmap the device does not hold is gone
a subtree is predicted whole: its record, its meta and genesis kinds, and its step's branch
a subtree of a subtree keeps its root and goes one deeper
a subtree on a step this device holds as deleted revives the step first, and the device notes it
a step that already owns a subtree answers it, and writes nothing
a step that opens a roadmap is refused a subtree
a subtree past eight deep is refused
a step the roadmap never held is gone
